Harris Says She Is Undecided
Some donors have also told Harris directly that a bid would be a long shot, according to multiple people familiar with the conversations, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.
Harris said at an NAACP event in Michigan in September, "I have not decided if I’m going to run again," according to the report.

People close to Emhoff expect he will support her if she decides to run, according to the report.
In her memoir of the 2024 campaign, "107 Days," Harris describes Emhoff as protective and supportive, the report noted.
Some of the people familiar with the conversations said Harris’ recent moves have made some donors uneasy about her intentions.
Some people who have known and worked with Harris are skeptical she will ultimately mount another run, the report said.
